title: Kurdyka-Łojasiewicz-based convergence analysis with approximate weakly convex subdifferentials: bundle, quadratic penalty, and moving balls approximation methods
summary: The Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz (KL) property has been widely used for establishing global sequential convergence and analyzing local convergence rate of optimization algorithms. Most existing analysis frameworks rely on the construction of a suitable KL potential function such that along the sequence generated, it admits sufficient descents and its exact subdifferentials are suitably controlled by successive changes of the iterates.
